merchandiseItemRenderer.title: Halloween 2026 – Liquid Limited Edition Vinyl
merchandiseItemRenderer.description: Light the pumpkins and dive into the Halloween mood. As night falls over Lofi Girl's world, jack-o'-lanterns begin to glow and the familiar streets take on a mysterious new look... With Pocky close by, she settles in as flickering candlelight, autumn shadows and Halloween beats fill the evening. This 14-track compilation brings together beatmakers from across the globe, blending cozy melodies with softly eerie rhythms. Drop the needle and let the chills begin. Vinyl Features Fluorescent Liquid Edition : A record sealed with fluorescent orange liquid that flows and shifts with every movement, in the colors of a pumpkin coming to life. Glow Effect : Placed in the dark under a light source, the fluorescent orange liquid lights up like a jack-o'-lantern glowing in the night. Custom Inner Sleeve : Exclusive sleeve featuring artwork of Lofi Girl's pumpkin-lit room, protecting your record with a touch of autumn charm. Illustrated Center Labels : Custom-designed to capture the warm, flickering aesthetic of Halloween 2026. Collector's Bonus : Includes an exclusive sticker featuring the main illustration. Technical Specifications Format : Single Vinyl 1 × 12" (Liquid Edition) Speed : 33⅓ RPM Duration : 14 tracks, approx. 30 minutes (15–16 min per side) Series : Official Release #48 – Halloween 2026 ️ Please Note : Due to the handcrafted and unique nature of liquid-filled vinyl, colors, liquid movement and small air bubbles may vary slightly from the preview images. Shipping & Quality Details Status : Limited Edition Release (Available while supplies last). Release Date : October 1, 2026. Expected Ship Date : January – February 2027. Collector-Grade Packaging : Premium jacket with high-quality finishes, designed to be a glowing centerpiece for your autumn collection. Authenticity : Official Lofi Girl release.

merchandiseItemRenderer.title: Fall Collection 2026 – Seasons Vinyls Part 3
merchandiseItemRenderer.description: The air turns sharp, the leaves turn gold, and the treehouse becomes the warmest place around. Lofi Girl spends this season up in the branches, Pocky curled beside her while the ground below slowly changes colour. Fall Collection 2026 is the record she puts on up there: an unreleased Lofi Girl compilation of amber-lit beats and autumn ambience, pressed on ochre marble vinyl. It is also the third panel of the Seasons Collection illustration. Autumn takes the top-left corner, sitting just above summer, and with this chapter in place the full picture is almost whole, one season left before the drawing closes. Vinyl Features Ochre Marble Pressing: A limited-edition marble vinyl the colour of late October light, made to sit on the shelf as much as on the platter. One Illustration, Four Records: Each vinyl in the Seasons 2026 series carries its own hand-drawn artwork, and the four fit together into a single scene. Autumn is the top-left piece. An Unreleased Autumn Compilation: 28 tracks gathered for this season only, sequenced for slow afternoons and golden evenings. Made For Your Desk: Put it on to settle into revision, to work through a long grey afternoon, or to let the day end quietly with the window open. Technical Specifications Format : 2 x 12" ochre marble vinyl (2LP) Speed : 33 1/3 RPM Duration : 01:04:28 (28 tracks, around 16 minutes per side) Series : Official Release #47 (2026 Seasons Collection #03) ️ Please Note : Due to the handcrafted nature and unique marble effect of these vinyl records, colors, patterns, and shades will vary from the preview images, making every single press entirely unique. Shipping & Quality Details Official Release Date : September 28th 2026 Estimated Shipping Date : Between January and February 2027 Collector-Grade Packaging : Each record is shipped in a reinforced recycled cardboard mailer with protective padding to ensure it arrives in mint condition. Authenticity : Official Lofi Girl product.
merchandiseItemRenderer.accessibilityTitle: Fall Collection 2026 – Seasons Vinyls Part 3, $44.99 , from Lofi Girl

merchandiseItemRenderer.title: Lofi House Vol.1 - Vinyl
merchandiseItemRenderer.description: The last email is sent, the sun is setting, and the record is already waiting on the deck. Lofi House brings you the first compilation from the brand new Lofi Girl radio: 31 new tracks where laid-back electro-inspired rhythms meet the warmth of lofi. This record is built for golden hours, afterwork sessions on the balcony and long evenings with friends who stay later than planned. Just like Lofi Teacher, put this beautiful orange splatter vinyl on and enjoy your downtime! Vinyl Features • A new genre in the Lofi Girl universe mixing our classic lofi beats with house music.• A limited edition, custom-made orange splatter pressing, swirled like a sunset, to fit the vibes of the new Lofi House radio.• 31 new tracks that move from slow sunset grooves to roadtrips with friends, or to simply unwind after work.• A collector record featuring artwork drawn by the Lofi Studio illustrators, with Lofi Teacher stepping into the lore after a quick cameo in a familiar classroom. Technical Specifications • Format: 2 × 12" Orange Splatter vinyl• Speed: 33 1/3 RPM• Duration: 01:00:00 (31 tracks)• Series: Official Release #46 (Lofi House Vol.01) Shipping & Quality Details • Official Release Date: September 17th 2026• Estimated Shipping Date: December 2026• Collector-Grade Packaging: Each record is shipped in a reinforced, eco-friendly mailer with protective padding to ensure it arrives in mint condition.• Authenticity: Official Lofi Girl product. ️ Please Note: Due to the handcrafted nature and unique marble effect of these vinyl records, colors, patterns, and shades will vary from the preview images, making every single press entirely unique.

merchandiseItemRenderer.title: Lofi Girl x Secret Lair - Special Vinyl Edition
merchandiseItemRenderer.description: Elevate your games with the ultimate tabletop soundtrack. "Lofi Girl x Secret Lair: beats to cast to" brings two worlds together, matching the distinct rhythm of Magic: The Gathering and soothing lofi study music. Soft card shuffles, land taps, and double-sleeved ASMR blend naturally into warm, lofi beats engineered for deep focus. Smooth down the tension of a complex stack, keep your heart rate cool during a tough topdeck, and let every turn flow naturally. Join Lofi Girl's dad as he shares his passion with his daughter, letting her peek into the art of deck building one card at a time. Tap in, tune out, and may the best deck win. Vinyl Features Double Marbled Vinyl : Two marbled blue 12" records, capturing the mystical color and energy of a Magic: The Gathering mana pool. Collector's Gatefold Artwork : An illustrated scene blending Lofi Girl's cozy world with the Secret Lair universe, printed on a premium gatefold jacket. 24 Lofi Tracks : 1 hour and 4 minutes of soothing beats, tuned to keep your focus sharp turn after turn. Technical Specifications Format : 2 × 12" Vinyl (Double LP) Speed : 33 RPM Weight : 180g Duration : 01:04:00 (24 tracks) Series : Collab — Lofi Girl x Secret Lair Audio : High-Fidelity Vinyl Master (Stereo) ️ Please Note : Due to the handcrafted and unique nature of these vinyl records, colors and shades may vary slightly from the preview images. Shipping & Quality Details Status : Limited Edition (Pre-order). Shipping : December 2026 Collector-Grade Packaging : Housed in a premium heavyweight gatefold jacket with enhanced artwork, complete with anti-static archival inner sleeves to guarantee pristine preservation. Authenticity : 100% Official Lofi Girl x Secret Lair collaboration.

merchandiseItemRenderer.title: Summer Collection 2026 – Seasons Vinyls Part 2
merchandiseItemRenderer.description: Golden hour energy in every beat. Bask in the warmth of breezy summer lofi. ️ Turn the page to a warmer chapter. The second installment of our 2026 Seasons Collection has arrived. This curated compilation captures the sun-kissed warmth of the season, lazy afternoon grooves, and the relaxing atmosphere of endless summer days. Featuring hours of cozy summer lofi, this record is your dedicated companion to help you catch rays, focus on your study sessions, or wind down after a long day. Vinyl Features A Seasonal Journey : The second installment of a limited four-part series celebrating the 2026 cycle. Each sleeve in the collection represents one corner of a larger, square-shaped artwork. By piecing this second vinyl together with the first, half of the final illustration is now revealed! Collect all four seasonal releases to complete the full picture. Summer Soundscape : A selection of 28 sun-kissed tracks infused with gentle bossa nova rhythms, specially mastered to bring out the warm depth of vinyl. Exclusive Visuals : Features original seasonal artwork on a premium gatefold sleeve, designed to be displayed as a piece of art in your home. Immersive Atmosphere : The perfect backdrop for sunny afternoons, backyard relaxation, or soundtracking your ultimate summer reset. Technical Specifications Format : Double Vinyl 2 × 12" (Cyan Blue Marble Edition) Speed : 33 1/3 RPM Duration : 01:00:00 (28 tracks) Series : Official Release #45 (2026 Seasons Collection #02) ️ Please Note : Due to the handcrafted nature and unique marble effect of these vinyl records, colors, patterns, and shades will vary from the preview images, making every single press entirely unique. Shipping & Quality Details Official Release Date : July 6th, 2026. Estimated Shipping Date : October 2026. Collector-Grade Packaging : Each record is shipped in a reinforced, eco-friendly mailer with protective padding to ensure it arrives in mint condition. Authenticity : Official Lofi Girl product.
